attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The pirates made off with some provisions.","severity":"minor","reason":"added outcome of the robbery; briefing only says the barge was robbed"},{"span":"The Calder Combine reports good harvests along the delta.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as if current; presented as an item in this bulletin"},{"span":"They always report good harvests when things are otherwise predictable.","severity":"minor","reason":"stated as fact; implies a pattern of reporting the briefing does not give"},{"span":"Three settlements are holding steady.","severity":"minor","reason":"adds a status ('holding steady') the briefing does not report"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"The bulletin leads correctly with the new item, but it pads with a repeat of old news presented as a current item and adds small unsupported details.
